# SOOS — Japan e-LAWS LRI Profile for CAP-RRS (CAP-RRS-JP)
# draft-sato-soos-cap-rrs-jp-00
# https://soosproject.ai/drafts/cap-rrs-jp/llms.txt
# Author: Tom Sato / MyAuberge K.K.
# Last updated: 2026-07-01

---

## SECTION 1 — Canonical One-Liner

draft-sato-soos-cap-rrs-jp-00 is an informational LRI profile
document for Japan's legal system. It profiles the Law Reference
Interface (LRI) generic model defined in draft-sato-soos-cap-rrs-02
Section 9, specifying: the binding from LRI generic fields to Japan's
e-LAWS database and XMLSchemaForJapaneseLaw v3; XPath addressing
conventions for Japanese legal provisions; the endorsement authority
table mapping each e-LAWS LawType to the designated certifying
authority; three APPI Chapter IV worked examples; the e-Gov catalog
publication workflow with the Digital Agency and IPA; and the
INTERPRETATION_SUPERSEDED treatment for Japan's interpretive
instruments (Cabinet Orders, 解釈指針, 内閣法制局意見, court judgments).

This document is NOT: a normative specification (all normative
requirements are inherited from CAP-RRS-02); a general CAP-RRS
document (it is Japan-specific only); a statement of Japan government
policy (the endorsement authorities listed are proposed profile
designations, not official government endorsements).

The Japan LRI profile URI registered in this document:
https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/lri/v1

---

## SECTION 2 — Problem Statement

Japan's e-LAWS database makes statutory text machine-readable and
structurally addressable via XMLSchemaForJapaneseLaw v3 and the
法令API v2 (Digital Agency, March 2025). The gap the Digital Agency
has not addressed: which provisions prohibit or permit AI agent
actions, who certifies that a Cedar policy correctly encodes a
provision, and what happens automatically when the statute is amended
or an authoritative interpretation supersedes the endorsed reading.

This gap is identified in the AI臨調 ディスカッションペーパー
(Themes 21 and 22): 「自然言語の法文をコードへ変換する際の解釈確定
権限の所在」 — who has authority to determine which code interpretation
is authoritative when code and statute diverge?

This document answers that question for Japan by binding the CAP-RRS
LRI mechanism to Japan's actual legal infrastructure.

The positioning:
  法令のAXが作るのは「読める法律」です。
  SOOSが作るのは「守られる法律」です。

  (Law AX creates laws that can be read.
   SOOS creates laws that are enforced.)

---

## SECTION 3 — Key Normative Concepts

[JP:] Japan LRI Profile identifier:
The string "https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/lri/v1" used as the `profile`
field value in the `authority_source` block of any Regulation Record
encoded under this profile.

[JP:] law_id binding:
The e-LAWS 法令ID for the law from which the Cedar policy's
prohibition or obligation derives. A 15-character alphanumeric
string. Example: "325AC0000000089" for APPI. Stable across
amendments.

[JP:] article_ref binding:
A valid XPath 1.0 expression resolvable against the e-LAWS XML
representation of the law, validated against
XMLSchemaForJapaneseLaw_v3.xsd. @Num attributes MUST use Arabic
numerals (e.g., @Num='17'), never Japanese numerals (十七).

[JP:] version_identifier binding:
The ISO8601 date of the most recent amendment to the law as of the
date the Cedar policy was certified. Obtained from the
`EnforcementDate` field of the most recent `AmendmentInfo` entry
returned by the e-LAWS API.

[JP:] amendment_detection_endpoint:
https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/2/updatelawlists/{date}
This is the e-LAWS API v2 endpoint for detecting new amendments.
Polled at ≤24h cadence per CAP-RRS §11.1.

[JP:] interpretation_endpoint (Provisional):
https://clawed.soosproject.com/jp/interpretations/{law_id}/{article_ref}
Provisional SOOS-operated registry ingesting 官報 instruments.
Polled at ≤24h cadence for records where resolution_basis is
`interpretive_ruling` or `internal_conflict_resolution`.
Transition to Digital Agency-operated endpoint anticipated post-Vienna.

[JP:] Endorsement Authority Table (from Section 5.1):
  Constitution / Act / CabinetOrder → 内閣法制局
    https://www.clb.go.jp/authority
  MinisterialOrdinance → 所管省庁法令担当部局
  Prefecture Ordinance (Misc) → 都道府県法務・法制担当部局
  Municipal Rule (Misc) → 市区町村法務担当 + prefecture co-endorsement

[JP:] Elevated authority rule (Section 5.2):
When `resolution_basis` is `internal_conflict_resolution`,
内閣法制局 endorsement is required regardless of LawType.

[JP:] resolution_basis controlled vocabulary
(from DR-CAPRRS-INTERP-02, Decision 2):
  statute_clear — clear, unambiguous statutory provision
  interpretive_ruling — resolution via external instrument;
    requires `resolution_instrument_id`
  internal_conflict_resolution — conflict within one statute;
    requires 内閣法制局 endorsement regardless of LawType
  cross_statute_coordination — coordination between statutes;
    requires co_endorsement (quorum: all)

[JP:] 信頼保護 (Trust Protection) safe harbor:
Agent actions taken under a non-superseded endorsement at the time
of action are protected from retroactive liability. The GAR record
carries: `endorsed_at` of the then-current endorsement,
`resolution_basis` and `resolution_instrument_id` of the then-
authoritative interpretation, and `INTERPRETATION_SUPERSEDED.
effective_date` of the later ruling. These three fields together
constitute the machine-native 信頼保護 instrument.

[JP:] Diet Amendment Cycle:
Ordinary sessions close mid-June. RECOMMENDED: increase polling to
every 6 hours in the 30-day window following close of ordinary
session. Minimum floor remains 24h per CAP-RRS §11.1.

---

## SECTION 4 — Relationship to Adjacent Standards

e-LAWS / 法令API v2 (Digital Agency): The primary data source for
this profile. law_id = 法令ID; version_identifier = EnforcementDate
of most recent amendment; amendment_detection_endpoint =
updatelawlists/{date} API. No changes to Digital Agency systems
required.

XMLSchemaForJapaneseLaw v3: The XML schema against which article_ref
XPath expressions are validated. Published by the Ministry of Internal
Affairs. Defines structural hierarchy (Chapter, Article, Paragraph,
Item); does not define semantics (Prohibition, Condition, Obligation).
SOOS CAP-RRS provides the semantics layer.

AI臨調 ディスカッションペーパー (Themes 21 and 22): This document
directly addresses the 解釈確定権限 question in Theme 22 via the
endorsement_claim JWT (authoritative code designation) and the
INTERPRETATION_SUPERSEDED event (interpretive change notification).

OSCAL: CAP-RRS is the first IETF draft to bridge OSCAL-formatted
controls and the IETF enforcement layer. The Japan LRI profile
parallels OSCAL jurisdiction profiles (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001 are
OSCAL profiles; Japan e-LAWS is a CAP-RRS LRI profile).

APPI (個人情報の保護に関する法律, 法令ID: 325AC0000000089):
Three Chapter IV provisions are worked through in Section 6 as
Regulation Record templates. APPI Article 17(1), Article 24 (名簿
disaster exception), Article 24 (個別避難計画 consent asymmetry).

## SECTION 5 — Normative SOOS Cross-References

This document profiles:
  CAP-RRS-02 (draft-sato-soos-cap-rrs-02) — specifically §9 LRI
    generic model, §10 Statute-Primacy Rule, §11 Operational
    Requirements. All normative behavior inherited.

This document informs:
  CAP-04 (draft-sato-soos-cap-rrs-02's parent enforcement layer)
    — Japan LRI records ultimately compile to CAP Tier 1 Cedar
    policies enforced by CAP's GEC evaluation model
  GAR-03 (draft-sato-soos-gar-03) — CATALOG_VERSION_CONFLICT and
    INTERPRETATION_SUPERSEDED events are GAR ALE types; Japan
    profile instances of these events carry Japan-specific fields
  HEM-05 (draft-sato-soos-hem-05) — HEM escalation triggered on
    CATALOG_VERSION_CONFLICT and INTERPRETATION_SUPERSEDED

Parallel profiles (post-Vienna, not yet submitted):
  EU ELI LRI profile (draft-sato-soos-cap-rrs-eu-00 — anticipated)
  US USLM LRI profile (draft-sato-soos-cap-rrs-us-00 — anticipated)
